import networkx as nx

# The McGee graph is the unique (3,7)-cage graph.
# It has 24 vertices.
G = nx.mcgee_graph()
edges = list(G.edges())
edges = [(u, v) if u < v else (v, u) for u, v in edges]
edges.sort()

# Check properties
girth = nx.girth(G)
degrees = [d for n, d in G.degree()]

print("Girth:", girth)
print("Min degree:", min(degrees))
print("Max degree:", max(degrees))
print("Num vertices:", G.number_of_nodes())

flat_edges = []
for u, v in edges:
    flat_edges.extend([u, v])
print("Edges:", flat_edges)
